purpose: Retrospective contact pass-1 bilinear interpolation point-density ablation for presentation
gridNotation: rows x columns (vertical x horizontal), including all four boundaries
selection: Exact uniform subsampling: row index 1+i*12/(R-1), column index 1+j*20/(C-1); original measurements only, no synthetic anchors, no score-based selection.
method: Existing A: bilinear forward interpolation of three magnetic components, inverted over fixed 181x181 XY candidates. No neural network or kNN.
fixedParameters: All non-knot parameters of the already frozen A1 are reused, including searchSteps=180 and residualLimitUT=3.662219138778697. That legacy display limit came from full pass-1 noise; only selected vectors fit each interpolation surface. Primary position metrics do not use display acceptance.
trainBackground: Selected pass-1 anchors use the existing row before/after linear correction.
testBackground: All 273 points of each pass use trimmed steady median minus preceding row baseline only. No future end baseline or target coordinate is an inference input.
interpretation: Pass1 contains N fitted placements and 273-N non-anchor placements from the same sessions; never report it as independent validation.
Pass2 and pass3 never enter any model. They are existing, previously inspected repeat datasets, not newly collected prospective tests.
Main 9/15/24/77/273 grids are fixed before results. Only 24->77->273 is a nested, isotropic 10->5->2.5mm sequence.
Run every 25 exact uniform shape combination and retain non-monotonic and worsening results.
More anchors need not improve every location or repeat; report actual outcomes without enforcing monotonicity.
Contact pass2 remains included as user requested, with historical acquisition/timing caveats preserved.
